group_key.description: Stable group identity, 'subject:<entity uuid>' — the thing this group of knowledge is ABOUT. Collected Knowledge is grouped by subject, never by source event or by moment: about-ness (perception_subject, SPEC-008/ADR-035) is the only axis the world records that is genuinely a topic, and both Compendium PRDs forbid grouping by raw timeline/log order. A record about several things is filed under exactly ONE of them — the co-subject it recurs with most on this page, for this viewer — so no item is ever printed twice. The group whose key is 'subject:' + this page's own entity id is the REMAINDER (records about the page's subject and nothing else nameable); it is always emitted FIRST and always carries a null group_label.

group_label.description: The viewer's own name for the group's subject (fn_display_name). NULL means the unheaded remainder group described in group_key — render its items directly under Collected Knowledge with no heading, because a heading-less block placed between two headed groups reads as belonging to the one above it. Groups after the remainder are ordered by recurrence (most records first), then recency, then id; items inside a group stay in in-world chronological order so a topic reads as it evolved.
